purpose: Document first-party discovery, official map/cadastre evidence, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official ƏMDX interactive map and TEKUIS materials are relevant first-party sources. A first-party Azerbaijani publication explicitly reports a detailed electronic real-estate cadastral database and digital cadastral map for Sumgayit. Direct anonymous retrieval of the live map host timed out, so its current JavaScript/configuration, service endpoint, schema, CRS and parcel response could not be inspected. No parcel polygon or source-specific attribute set was retained.
registryAssessment: Local/public-service evidence is present through the State Property Service interactive map, Sumgayit-specific cadastral project evidence and the listed Sumgayit territorial office. This establishes a local cadastral-map custodian context, not a verified open parcel API or complete citywide public dataset.
